name: Sentora RLUSD Main
oneLiner: senRLUSDv2 is Sentora's RLUSD Morpho Vault V2 share; yield and losses change NAV, and cash redemption depends on idle RLUSD.
collateral: RLUSD lending positions against cbBTC, FXRP, syrupUSDC, wstETH, USDe, weETH, kBTC, WBTC. Allocations change under curator controls; borrower collateral is distinct from the underlying deposited token.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 deposit/mint and withdraw/redeem exchange shares for RLUSD at the current asset conversion rate. Lending interest, fees and realized losses change NAV. liquidityAdapter() is zero at the pinned review; ordinary cash redemptions use idle assets unless assets are first deallocated. Shared market liquidity and an in-kind position exit do not promise full-size cash redemption.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Exact Ethereum deployment 0x6dc58a0fdfc8d694e571dc59b9a52eeea780e6bf is immutable VaultV2, issuing transferable ERC-4626 operational shares over RLUSD, not a direct fiat or parent-reserve ownership claim. asset(), decimals(), totalSupply(), convertToAssets() and ordinary one-share redeem simulation were reverified at Ethereum block 26107702. The protocol-position archetype intentionally differs from the fiat-cash parent.
